name: Gourmandise the Euro Bakery (Draper) Butter Croissant, Brioche French Toast or Brie Grilled Cheese
brandOrRestaurant: Gourmandise the Euro Bakery & Café (Draper, UT)
whyItWorks: Right near TownePlace Suites Draper, Gourmandise bakes authentic European butter croissants, Crème Brûlée Brioche French Toast, Ham & Swiss Croissants, and Gourmet Grilled Cheese using finely milled, long-fermented flours with zero roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: For breakfast, order the Ham & Swiss Croissant, Plain Butter Croissant with scrambled eggs, or Brioche French Toast (berries on the side); for lunch, try the Turkey Havarti Croissant or Grilled Cheese without onion jam.
watchOuts: Contains European butter and cream—take lactase enzymes; skip lemon tarts (citrus trigger) and seeded raspberry Napoleons
